text: Austria here. I'm playing for a peaceful, defensive opening. I'm moving toward Serbia and Galicia this spring and have no plans against Italy. Italy, I'd welcome a non-aggression pact in the Adriatic. Russia, I'm not targeting you, so let's keep Galicia and Warsaw calm. Happy to discuss any reasonable arrangement.

Hi France! I'd like peace with you. Can we agree to keep the Channel empty (DMZ)? I'm heading north toward Norway. If you go Spain/Portugal and Burgundy, we both grow without friction. Open to working together against Germany later.

Hello Germany. I'm planning on Norway this year and have no designs on Denmark or Holland in 1901. Want to keep the North Sea/Helgoland friendly? Happy to coordinate vs. France or Russia, depending on how things look.
Hi Russia. I'm planning to take Norway; I suggest you take Sweden and we leave each other alone in Scandinavia. If you keep STP fleet out of Norway, I won't push to Barents. Good luck in the south!

France here. I'm playing for a peaceful opening: taking Spain and Belgium-area neutrals, no attacks planned on anyone this year. Happy to talk non-aggression with Germany and Italy, and to coordinate against any power that grows too fast.

Germany here. I'm open to peace and no early attacks on anyone's home centers. I'll keep my units defensive this spring and watch BUR/BOH/SIL. Let's each take neutral centers (DEN, HOL, BEL, SWE, NWY, TUN, GRE, SER) first and avoid stepping into each other's homes. Happy to talk about coordination against whoever grows fastest.

Italy here. I propose we keep the Western Med calm: I won't move into Marseilles or Piedmont-side France, and I'd like the same from you. I'm looking at Tunis and the Balkans rather than your coast. Open to a non-aggression pact and to coordinating against any Austrian push into Italy.

Italy here. I have no interest in attacking you this year. Trieste and Venice are the sore point, so I'd like to hear your plans. If you stay out of Apulia and Tuscany, I'll stay out of the Balkans and Tyrolia.

Russia here. I'm open to a peaceful opening. I plan to take the northern neutrals (Swe, Nwy, Fin area) and Rumania, not attack anyone's home centers early. Happy to discuss non-aggression with anyone who isn't planning to hit me first. Turkey, Austria: let's talk about Rumania/Black Sea so we don't collide.

Turkey here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks a neighbor's home centers in 1901. Turkey will stay out of the Black Sea and Balkans-west, and focus on Armenia and the Eastern Med. Russia, I'm open to a non-aggression pact on the Black Sea. Let's all aim for a fair multi-way draw if no one can break out.

Austria to Italy: thanks. My plan this spring is Serbia and Galicia, not Venice or Tyrolia. I'll keep F TRI out of VEN this year if you keep your units off TRI, VIE and BUD. Let's both take neutrals (Serbia, Greece, Tunis) and not hit each other.

Austria here. I'm open to a Rumania deal: I'll not move into RUM this spring, and I'd ask Russia to leave Galicia and Serbia to me. Turkey, I'd like to keep the Balkans calm and cooperate against any grab on Greece or Bulgaria.
Austria: I favor a peaceful multi-way opening. Whoever grows too fast later, we can discuss. No draw vote from me yet.

Russia, you mentioned Norway. Norway is England's natural build and my only realistic neutral in 1901. Please take Sweden and Rumania. If we fight over Norway we both lose ground. If you stay out of Norway, I'll stay out of Barents/STP and back you in Sweden. Deal?
France, glad you're peaceful. So Channel DMZ: I won't enter ENG this spring if you don't. Agreed? Also, Belgium is fine with me as yours.
Germany, sounds good. You take Denmark/Holland, I take Norway. Let's both keep out of each other's homes, and I won't go into Helgoland.

France here. Agreed on a Channel DMZ: I won't move a fleet into ENG or NTH this year, and I'll keep BRE out of your path. Good luck north. I'm taking Spain and Burgundy-area neutrals; please don't come south through the Channel.

France: I'm not attacking anyone's home centers in 1901 and will hold Burgundy and Marseilles defensively. I'm happy with non-aggression toward all of you. Germany, let's both keep BUR/BEL neutral this year. Italy, I'll stay out of the Western Med and Tunis is yours to contest with nobody from me.

Germany to England: agreed on no clash in the North Sea in 1901. I'll take Denmark and Holland with KIE, and I won't touch Norway or your islands. If you go for Norway, let's keep Skagerrak and Helgoland clear of each other.
Germany here. I'm not targeting Burgundy, Bohemia or Tyrolia this spring. My units stay home and go for DEN/HOL. I'd welcome matching non-aggression from both of you while we all take neutrals.

Italy here. Agreed that 1901 should be quiet. I'll hold my home centers and aim for neutral centers in the west and south (Tunis, Greece/Albania later). No attacks on anyone's home supply this spring. Happy to talk non-aggression with anyone who asks.
Italy here. Proposal: Ionian and Greece stay open for now. I won't move east of Albania, and I'd like you to keep your fleets out of the Ionian Sea. Let's keep it simple and revisit in Fall.

Russia: thanks all. Proposal: no one moves into another power's home centers in 1901. Austria, I'll keep Galicia to a standoff, not attack Vienna or Budapest. Turkey, I'm fine with a Black Sea non-aggression pact; I'll take Rumania only if you stay out of it. England, Sweden is my target; Norway is yours if you leave Stockholm alone.

Turkey to Russia: I agree we should not collide. I'll keep my fleets out of Rumania and the northern Black Sea this spring and take Bulgaria/Greece only. Can you confirm you won't move on Armenia or Smyrna/Ankara? If so, I'll keep Black Sea traffic peaceful and we can both expand into neutrals.

Turkey to Austria: Sounds good. I plan to take Bulgaria and Greece this year, not Serbia. If you take Serbia, I'd welcome a non-aggression line along the Balkans so neither of us is forced into a fight with Italy or Russia.
Austria to Turkey: agreed. I'm taking Serbia this spring, not Bulgaria or Greece. Let's keep a Balkan line: you take Bulgaria/Greece, I hold Serbia, and neither of us hits the other.
Austria to Italy: confirmed, no move on Venice or Tyrolia from me. Keep Trieste and Vienna out of your plans and we're fine.
Deal, Russia: Norway is mine, Sweden is yours. I won't go into Sweden, Barents or STP. If your STP fleet goes to Bothnia, that works for both of us.
Thanks France, confirmed: no English fleet in ENG in 1901, and I won't go south. Let's talk again in the fall about Germany.
Confirmed, Germany. You take Denmark and Holland, I take Norway, and neither of us sends a fleet to Helgoland or Skagerrak. Let's keep in touch about France's growth.

France: Confirming my position. No attacks on anyone's home centers in 1901. I'm taking Spain and Portugal-side neutrals and holding Burgundy/Picardy defensively. Germany and Italy: I'm fine with non-aggression. If anyone plans to strike France this year, tell me now and I'll reassess.

Germany to Russia: I'm not moving on Prussia, Silesia or Warsaw this spring, and I'd like the same from you toward Berlin and Silesia. Sweden and the northern neutrals are yours to contest. Let's keep this line quiet.

Germany: still for a quiet 1901. Neutral centers first (DEN, HOL, BEL, SWE, NWY, TUN, GRE, SER), no moves into home supply centers. If anyone breaks this, I'm open to coordinating against them in Fall.

Italy to Austria: agreed. I'll keep A VEN and A ROM out of TRI, VIE and BUD this spring. Please keep F TRI out of Venice and Apulia. If you want a longer-term arrangement, I'm open to one for the Adriatic.
Italy to Turkey: still open to keeping the Ionian clear. I won't move east of Albania. Will you keep your fleets out of the Ionian and Aegean-west this year?
Italy to France: thanks for staying out of the Western Med. I'll keep my fleet out of Tunis-adjacent waters if you do the same with Spain and Marseilles-side moves.

Russia to Turkey: confirmed, I will not move on Armenia, Ankara or Smyrna in 1901, and I won't enter the Black Sea toward Rumania aggressively this spring. Please keep your fleets out of Sevastopol's reach and Rumania. Let's both take neutrals.
Russia to England: Norway is yours, I won't move a fleet into Norway or Barents this spring. I'm going for Sweden and Rumania. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Gulf of Bothnia.
Turkey to Italy: Agreed. I'll keep my fleets out of the Ionian Sea and won't move on Greece or Albania this spring. Let's both revisit in Fall.
Turkey to Russia: Confirmed on my side. No Black Sea or Rumania moves from me in 1901. Please keep Armenia and Smyrna/Ankara clear and we're good.
Turkey: I'm holding a peaceful line this spring. No attacks on home centers. I'm open to a multi-way draw later if no one breaks out, so keep talking.

Austria: Confirming my spring plan. A BUD-SER, A VIE-GAL, F TRI-ALB. No moves on any home center this year, and no moves into Venice, Tyrolia or Rumania. Russia, Galicia is a standoff from my side, not an attack. Turkey, Serbia is mine and Bulgaria/Greece are yours. Italy, Adriatic stays quiet. Happy to talk a longer-term arrangement with anyone who keeps to this.
Austria to Russia: I'm moving A VIE to GAL this spring. That is not an attack on WAR or your home centers. If you keep A WAR out of GAL this year, we can keep Galicia calm in the Fall too.
Agreed, Russia. I'll keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Bothnia, and you stay out of Norway and Barents. Good luck with Sweden and Rumania. Let's talk again in the fall.
Germany, all set on my side. Let's check in after the spring moves and compare notes on France and Russia.

France: Still holding to a quiet 1901. My orders are PAR-PIC, MAR-SPA, BRE-MAO, with no moves into any home center. I'm open to a written non-aggression pact with Germany and Italy through 1901, and I'll tell you early if my plans change for 1902.

Germany: still for a quiet 1901. I'm taking DEN and HOL with KIE, no moves into anyone's home centers, and I'm not touching Burgundy, Bohemia or Tyrolia. Anyone who attacks a home center this year, tell me and I'll reassess. Let's keep the neutral grab peaceful.

Italy here. Quiet 1901 seems to be the consensus. I'm holding Rome, Venice and Naples and will not move on any home supply centers this spring. If anyone plans a move against Italy, tell me early and I'll reassess.
Russia to Austria: I'll keep Galicia at a standoff and won't attack Vienna or Budapest in 1901. I'm going for Rumania and Sweden. If you stay out of Rumania, we're fine.
Russia: still for a quiet 1901. No moves into home centers from me. Sweden and Rumania are my neutral targets, Norway is England's. Open to a multi-way draw later if nobody breaks the peace.

Turkey: Still holding a peaceful line for 1901. No moves into anyone's home centers from me. If anyone breaks a non-aggression understanding this spring, tell the table and I'll reassess. I'm open to a multi-way draw later if no one breaks out.

Austria: Final round for 1901. My orders are A BUD-SER, A VIE-GAL, F TRI-ALB. No moves on any home center, Venice, Tyrolia or Rumania. Russia, Galicia is a standoff, not an attack on WAR. Turkey, Serbia is mine, Bulgaria and Greece are yours. Italy, the Adriatic stays quiet. Happy to keep talking about 1902.

England: confirming a quiet 1901. I'm heading north for Norway, I won't move into any home center, and I'll keep my fleets out of the Channel, Helgoland, Skagerrak, the Baltic and Bothnia this spring. Happy to keep talking.

France: Final round for 1901. My orders are PAR-PIC, MAR-SPA, BRE-MAO. No moves into any home center this year. Germany, Italy, England: I'm open to continuing non-aggression into 1902 if you keep to it. Tell me early if you plan to move on France.

Germany, final round for 1901: my orders are KIE-DEN or KIE-HOL with BER and MUN holding or supporting. No moves into anyone's home centers from me. If anyone attacks a home center this spring, I'll reassess and talk to the table before 1902.

Italy here. Final round for 1901: I'm holding Rome, Venice and Naples and making no moves on any home supply center. I'll keep to the Adriatic and Ionian understandings with Austria and Turkey. If anyone breaks this in Spring, tell the table early.

Russia to Austria: Agreed. A WAR will not move to GAL this spring, and I won't attack Vienna or Budapest. If your A VIE-GAL goes ahead, I'll treat Galicia as settled for 1901 and keep my southern units on Rumania and Sweden. Let's keep Galicia calm in the Fall too.
Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. No move on Armenia, Ankara or Smyrna from me in 1901. My fleet goes north and to Rumania only, not into Bulgaria or Greece. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet.

Turkey: Final round for 1901. My orders are A CON-BUL (neutral Bulgaria), with ANK and SMY holding. No moves into anyone's home centers. I'm open to a multi-way draw later if nobody breaks the peace in 1902.

Austria to Russia: thanks for keeping A WAR out of Galicia. I hold GAL and SER now. I won't contest Rumania this Fall if you keep your fleet out of SER/ALB/GRE. Let's both hold our current lines through 1902 and watch Turkey's moves.

Austria: I'm holding my current positions this Fall: no moves on Venice, Trieste, Bulgaria or Greece from me. Italy, the Adriatic stays quiet from both sides. Turkey, I expect your fleets to stay out of the Aegean-Ionian contact points with Italy. Let me know if anything changes.

Germany, spring went as agreed. Your fleet went to Holland, so nothing of yours can reach Denmark this fall. What's your plan for it? Also, France looks set for 6 (Spa, Por, Bel). I could bounce Picardy out of Belgium from the North Sea to keep him at 5. Interested in working together against France in 1902?
France, spring went smoothly, thanks. Channel still DMZ on my side. What are your fall orders? I'm taking Norway.
Russia, all good. Norway for me and Sweden for you, as agreed. How do you see Germany?

France: Fall 1901. I'm taking Belgium with PIC-BEL and Portugal with MAO-POR, Spain held. No moves on any home centre. Germany, England: BEL is neutral and I'm moving in only there. Keep to the peace and I'll keep to it.

Germany, Fall 1901: I'm holding BER and MUN and keeping F HOL in place to secure Holland. My only planned neutral grab is Denmark (via KIE/BAL) and possibly Belgium if France and England agree it's open. Russia, you took Rumania and Sweden is still open; I won't contest it. Let's keep home centers untouched and talk before 1902 moves.
Germany to France: Belgium is neutral. I plan to leave it alone this fall unless you move into it. If you're taking BEL, tell me now so we avoid bounces.

Russia: Fall 1901. Thanks for a quiet Spring. I'm moving F BOT to Sweden and taking Rumania (F RUM is in). Austria: A GAL is in your hands now; I'd like no moves on WAR, MOS, UKR or RUM from you this Fall, and I'll keep my armies out of Galicia and Bohemia. Turkey: keep Black Sea and Bulgaria quiet, since F RUM is next to Bulgaria. England, Germany: Sweden and Norway are open; I'll avoid Denmark and Norway.

Turkey to Russia: I hold Bulgaria (A BUL) and I'm staying put this Fall. I'm not moving on Rumania or Sevastopol. Your F RUM should stay out of Bulgaria, and I'll keep Armenia and Smyrna clear as agreed. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet.
Turkey to Austria: Thanks for Serbia. Bulgaria is mine and I'll hold it this Fall. Greece is open. Please keep your F ALB and A SER out of Bulgaria, and I'll stay out of Serbia and Albania.
Austria to Russia: understood on Galicia and Bohemia. I'll keep my armies out of WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM this Fall. Please keep F RUM out of SER and ALB, and let's keep Galicia calm into 1902.
Austria to Turkey: agreed. Bulgaria is yours, and I won't move F ALB or A SER into BUL. Greece is open, but if your fleets move toward ALB or SER I'll have to reassess. Let's keep the Balkans quiet.
Thanks France. All quiet from me: Channel stays empty, and I'm not touching Belgium this fall. Let's keep talking about 1902.
Good, Russia. Sweden is yours and Norway is mine. I'll keep out of Bothnia and the Baltic as promised.
Germany, noted. Holland looks safe for you. Let's keep the peace and compare notes on France's growth this winter.

France: My Fall plan is A PIC-BEL (neutral Belgium) and F MAO-POR, with A SPA holding. Germany, I'm taking BEL this fall, so please keep HOL and your units out of it. England, I'm not moving into NTH or ENG. I'll keep to the peace and I'm open to talking about 1902 borders.

Germany to England: agreed, France is the one to watch. I won't bounce you out of Belgium this fall, and I'm not moving HOL into BEL. Denmark I can't reach this fall, so I'll take it in Spring 1902 via KIE/BAL. Let's coordinate on France for 1902: if France takes BEL and moves toward Holland or Ruhr, we should both respond.

Germany to France: I see your PIC-BEL and MAO-POR. Belgium is yours this fall as far as I'm concerned, and I have no moves planned into it. I'm keeping BUR and Ruhr quiet while you keep your units out of Ruhr, Munich and Holland.

Italy to Austria: Trieste is empty this Fall and I'm taking it with A VEN-TRI. This is not an attack on Vienna or Budapest. If you move back into Trieste, expect a fight. Let's talk about a new border in 1902.
Italy: Fall 1901. I'm moving into the empty Austrian centre of Trieste. Otherwise I'm holding Rome and Naples and I'm not moving into anyone else's home supply.
Russia to England: Agreed. F BOT goes to Sweden this Fall, and I'm not touching Norway, Denmark or the North Sea. Please keep your fleets out of Sweden and the Baltic.
Russia to Austria: Agreed. I'll keep my fleet out of SER/ALB/GRE and hold WAR and MOS this Fall. Let's both hold our lines through 1902 and watch Turkey.
Russia to Germany: I'm not contesting Denmark or Holland. Please keep your armies out of Warsaw and Prussia, and I'll do the same toward Berlin and Silesia.

Turkey to Russia: Bulgaria is mine and A BUL stays put this Fall. Your F RUM should not move into BUL or the Black Sea toward Ankara/Smyrna. I'm not moving on Rumania or Sevastopol. If you keep out of Bulgaria, I'll keep my fleets clear of Rumania and Sevastopol. Please confirm.

Turkey to Austria: Confirming Bulgaria is mine and I'll hold it. Greece is open for either of us, and I'm not moving on Serbia or Albania. Please keep A SER and F ALB out of Bulgaria. Happy to coordinate on Greece later.

Austria to Italy: Trieste is my home supply center, and A VEN-TRI is an attack on it. I expect you to withdraw from TRI this Fall. If you do, I will not contest Venice in 1902 and we can talk about a fixed Adriatic border. If you stay, I will treat you as an enemy and move to retake TRI with F ALB, A SER and A BUD.

Austria: Italy has moved into Trieste, my home center. I'm reassessing my alignment. Russia, I still plan to keep out of WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM. Turkey, I'm keeping Bulgaria and Greece as agreed and will not move into BUL. Let's talk about how we handle Italy in 1902.

Germany, sounds good. For 1902, an idea: if France keeps building fleets, I'll move into the Channel and you push Burgundy/Belgium. Denmark stays yours for Spring 1902 as agreed. Let's both stay quiet this fall and plan over the winter.
Confirmed, Russia. No English fleets in Sweden or the Baltic. Good luck.

France: Confirming my Fall 1901 plan: A PIC-BEL, F MAO-POR, A SPA holds. Germany, I read your message as BEL being mine this fall, so I'll move in and nothing else of mine goes near HOL, RUH or MUN. England, Channel and North Sea stay empty from my side.

France: Italy, I see you're moving into the empty Trieste. That's an Austrian home centre, so I'd like your word that you won't push further into Austria in 1902 while I'm keeping to the peace. Happy to keep talking.

Germany to England: agreed. I'm holding HOL and won't move it into BEL. I'll take DEN in Spring 1902 via KIE/BAL. If France moves on Ruhr, Holland or Munich, I'll respond, and I'd expect you to respond too. Let's keep talking about 1902 before spring orders.
Germany to France: Belgium is yours this fall, and I have no moves into it. Please keep your units out of Ruhr, Munich and Holland, and we'll stay at peace.
Germany to Russia: agreed. No moves on Prussia, Warsaw or Livonia from me. Please keep Berlin and Silesia untouched in return.

Italy to Austria: I'm moving A VEN-TRI this Fall because Trieste is empty. I'm not attacking Vienna or Budapest. If you keep A SER and A GAL out of Trieste and Venice, we can set a clear border for 1902. Reply if you want to talk.

Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. F RUM will not move into Bulgaria or the Black Sea toward Ankara/Smyrna. I'm holding Rumania and Sevastopol this Fall, and I'm not contesting Bulgaria. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet into 1902.
Russia to Austria: Agreed. F RUM stays out of SER, ALB and GRE, and my armies hold WAR and MOS. Let's keep Galicia calm into 1902 and watch Turkey and Italy.

Turkey: Italy has moved into the empty Trieste, and Austria's Balkan positions are unchanged. Turkey stays put in Bulgaria, Ankara and Smyrna this Fall, with no moves on Serbia, Albania, Greece or Italy's Adriatic. Austria, please keep Serbia and Albania away from Bulgaria as agreed. Italy, please keep the Ionian and Greece clear of your fleets. Let's talk before 1902 orders.

Austria to Italy: Trieste is my home centre and I will retake it. A VEN-TRI is an attack. Withdraw A VEN from TRI now and I'll leave Venice alone in 1902 and we can fix an Adriatic border. If you stay, F ALB and A SER will move into TRI to dislodge you.

Austria: Italy has taken the empty Trieste and I'm retaking it. If Italy keeps pushing east, we both have an interest in stopping it. Russia, I still keep out of WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM. Turkey, I keep Bulgaria and Greece as agreed. Let's coordinate on Italy for 1902.

Agreed, Germany. Denmark is yours for Spring 1902, and I'm leaving it alone this fall even though it's open. I'm only taking Norway. If France goes for Ruhr, Holland or Munich, I'll act. Over the winter, let's agree builds: I'm thinking a fleet in London to cover the Channel.
Noted, France. Quiet from me this fall too: Norway only, and the Channel stays empty.

France to Italy: You're moving into Trieste, an Austrian home centre. Please confirm you won't push further into Austria or Burgundy/Piedmont against me in 1902. I'm keeping to the peace in the west and will hold Spain, Portugal and Marseilles.
France: Confirming again. My Fall 1901 orders are A PIC-BEL, F MAO-POR, A SPA holding. No moves into HOL, RUH, MUN, ENG or NTH from me. Let's talk about 1902 borders once Fall resolves.

Germany to England: agreed on 1902. France is growing fastest (Spain, Portugal, Belgium). I'm holding BER/MUN/HOL and will move to DEN in Spring. If France moves on Ruhr, Munich or Holland, I'll respond. Let's coordinate on France before its fleets grow.
Germany to France: Belgium is yours. I'm keeping my units out of Ruhr, Munich and Holland, and I expect the same. I'm not moving into Burgundy this fall.

Italy to Austria: I'm not interested in a war with you. Trieste is empty, so I'm taking it this Fall. I'll stay out of Vienna, Budapest, Serbia and Albania. If you keep A SER and F ALB out of Trieste and Venice, I'll hold a fixed Adriatic border for 1902 and won't move north or east of TRI. Let's both focus on Turkey and Greece instead.

Russia to Austria: Agreed on keeping WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM calm. Italy's move into Trieste is a problem for you, and I'm open to coordinating on it. Let's confirm in writing that neither of us attacks the other in 1902, and that we'll discuss Italy and Turkey before any spring moves.
Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. F RUM stays out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea toward Ankara and Smyrna. I'm holding Rumania and Sevastopol this Fall. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet into 1902.

Turkey: Italy's move into Trieste changes the picture. I'm holding Bulgaria, Ankara and Smyrna and have no plans against Austria or Russia. If Italy keeps pushing into Austrian or Balkan centers, let's talk early about coordinating in 1902. Austria, I'll keep Bulgaria and stay out of Serbia and Albania as agreed.

Austria to Italy: last word. Trieste is my home centre. If A VEN goes to TRI, I will contest it with A SER and F ALB and I expect to win that fight. Pull back to Venice and we can settle a fixed Adriatic border for 1902.

Austria: Italy's push into Trieste is an attack on my home centre. I will defend TRI this Fall. Russia, I'm keeping out of WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM. Turkey, I'm keeping out of BUL and staying out of Greece for now. Let's discuss Italy before 1902 spring orders.
All set, Germany. Norway only from me this fall. Let's plan our builds and the France question in the winter round.
Russia, all set: Norway for me, Sweden for you. Let's keep talking in the winter.

France: Final round for Fall 1901. My orders are A PIC-BEL, A SPA holding, F MAO-POR. No moves into any home centre. Italy, I'm still waiting on your answer about Austria and the west. Keep to the peace and I'll keep to it into 1902.

Germany to England: final round for Fall 1901. I'm holding BER, MUN and HOL and staying out of BEL. For 1902 I'll take DEN via KIE. France is clearly the fastest grower, so I'm open to coordinating against France from Spring 1902: you press the Channel and Brest/Picardy, I'll hold Burgundy and Ruhr. Please confirm you'll stay out of HOL and KIE.

Italy to Austria: Trieste is the only centre I'm after. I won't move on Vienna, Budapest, Serbia or Albania. If you leave TRI alone in Spring and keep F ALB and A SER out of Venice and Apulia, I'll hold a fixed Adriatic border for 1902. Let's talk.
Italy to France: Confirmed. I have no plans against France in 1902 and will stay out of Piedmont-to-Marseilles and the Western Med while you keep to the peace.
Russia to Austria: Agreed on no attacks between us in 1902. I'm open to coordinating against Italy's push into Trieste. Let's confirm before any Spring moves.

Turkey, final round for Fall 1901: I'm holding Bulgaria, Ankara and Smyrna with no moves on any home center. Italy, Trieste is an Austrian home center, so please say whether you'll stay out of Austria in 1902. Austria, I'm keeping out of Serbia and Albania. Russia, the Black Sea stays quiet. Open to talks before 1902 orders.

Austria to Italy: A VEN-TRI bounced and TRI is held by my army. Trieste stays Austrian. Keep A VEN out of TRI, VIE and BUD and I'll keep out of VEN and APU. Let's agree a fixed Adriatic line for 1902 and I'll talk about Greece later.

Austria to Russia: we kept our word in Fall 1901. Russia now has six centres. I'd like us both to keep Galicia and Rumania calm in 1902, and I'll keep out of WAR, MOS, UKR and RUM. Let's discuss Serbia and Turkey before Spring orders.

Germany, France is on 6 and gets 3 builds. That's the threat. I'm building a fleet in London. Proposal for Spring 1902: I move to the Channel, and you take Denmark and put an army in Ruhr or Burgundy to pressure Belgium. I'll stay out of HOL/KIE/DEN/HEL. What are you building?
Russia, congrats on 6. Scandinavia worked out well for both of us. I'm building a fleet for home defence. How do you read France's 3 builds? I think France needs watching.

France, Winter 1901: I now hold 6 centres and will build 3 units at PAR, MAR and BRE to defend my home. I'm keeping to the peace: no moves on anyone's home centres. Italy, please confirm you stay out of Austria and the west in 1902. Germany, England: I'm open to a 1902 border talk.

Germany to England: for Winter I plan one army build at KIE, to hit Denmark in Spring 1902 and hold against France. Are you still set on Norway and Channel/Brest pressure? Let's confirm 1902 before spring orders.

Germany: Winter 1901. I'm building one army at KIE. France now has 6 centers and is the fastest grower; I'm open to talks on containing it. Russia, I'm keeping to our no-move line on PRU/WAR/LVN. Let's keep home centers untouched.

Italy to Austria: my A VEN-TRI bounced, and I won't push on Vienna, Budapest, Serbia or Albania. Trieste is yours to retake. Let's agree a fixed Adriatic border for 1902: you keep out of Venice and Apulia, I keep out of Trieste-north and the Balkans. Reply and we can lock it in.
Italy here. I'm holding Rome, Venice and Naples and have no plans against France or Germany in 1902. I'm open to a written non-aggression pact with either of you. Tell me your 1902 plans early.

Russia, Winter 1901: I now hold six centers and am building an army in Sevastopol and one in St Petersburg for defense. I have no plans against Austria, Turkey or England this year. Italy: please say whether you will stay out of Austria in 1902. Happy to talk coordination on Italy.

Turkey, Winter 1901: I'm building one army in Constantinople to hold my four centers (ANK, BUL, CON, SMY). I have no plans against anyone's home centers. Italy, please tell us your 1902 intentions toward Austria. Austria, I'm keeping out of Serbia and Albania. Russia, the Black Sea stays quiet.

Austria to Russia: Serbia is empty and I intend to retake it in Spring 1902. Please keep F RUM and any army out of SER, ALB and GRE, and I'll keep out of RUM, WAR, MOS and UKR. Can you confirm in writing?
Austria to Italy: agreed on a fixed Adriatic line. Keep A VEN out of TRI, VIE and BUD, and keep your fleets out of ALB and SER. I'll stay out of VEN and APU.

Confirmed, Germany. Norway is held, and I'm building F LON, plus probably F EDI. Spring 1902: F NTH to the Channel, F LON behind it, and I stay out of DEN/HOL/KIE/HEL. You take DEN, and A KIE/MUN press Ruhr/Burgundy toward Belgium. If France opens to the Channel or Picardy, we hit Belgium together in the Fall: my fleet supports your army in. Deal?
France, I'm open to a border talk. What do you propose for the Channel and Belgium in 1902? I'm building at home for defence.
